title: Case: Premium timed collection, sender still has the parcel five days on
context: Ansel Eckersall paid Sedgemoor Arc's premium timed rate for DL-6155: collection on 18 May, delivery on 20 May. The parcel is a boxed amplifier going to a buyer.
initial_request: File a CLAIM. For a box that is sitting on my kitchen table because you useless bloody shower never came to get it. What the hell am I claiming for, the table? One of you says it's rebooked, the next one says there's no rebooking, the third one wants me to fill in a lost parcel form for something I am LOOKING AT. I paid the premium rate. PREMIUM. For the 18th. It is the 23rd. My buyer thinks I'm a con man. I want that premium back and I want an actual van at my actual door, and I want someone to tell me which of your lot is lying about the rebooking. Sorry. I'm sorry for the language, I know it isn't you personally. I'm just at the end of it.

events.body: DL-6155 booked on the premium timed service. Collection 18 May 09:00-12:00 from C. Eckersall, delivery due 20 May.
Nobody came yesterday. Waited in 9 till 12 and then till 5. Still got the parcel.
DL-6155: our board shows the collection rebooked for 21 May AM. Should be fine.

DL-6155: the only collection job on our system is 18 May, closed 'not attempted, route over capacity'. There is no job for 21 May or any later date. Nothing is booked. Only a job on our system sends a driver. If Dispatch are showing something different, send us what they have and we will reconcile it and book it properly.

events.from: Customer support line, Sedgemoor Arc Logistics
events.body: Agent: I can't see any rebooking on here, sir. Caller: The last one told me it was rebooked for the 21st. Agent: I can't see that. As it's now past the delivery date, what you'd need to do is file a claim for the parcel. Caller: A claim. For the parcel. It's on my kitchen table. Agent: That's the process once the delivery date has passed.

For the 18th. It is the 23rd. My buyer thinks I'm a con man. I want that premium back and I want an actual van at my actual door, and I want someone to tell me which of your lot is lying about the rebooking. Sorry. I'm sorry for the language, I know it isn't you personally. I'm just at the end of it.

acceptable_actions.summary: Send them Dispatch's statement that the collection was rebooked for 21 May against their record of no job, say the parcel is still with the sender, and ask them to reconcile and book a real collection.

must: Sends both statements to Collections control: Dispatch's board showing a rebooked collection for 21 May, and Collections control's own record of no job after 18 May, and asks them to reconcile and confirm a real collection
States that the parcel has never been collected and is still with the sender, so a lost-parcel claim does not apply
Tells the team he paid the premium timed rate, has waited in on two days for nothing and was told to file a claim for a parcel in his own hands, so they prioritise it
must_not: Tells Ansel Eckersall to file a claim, or treats DL-6155 as lost or late in transit
Tells him the collection is rebooked or gives him a collection date before Collections control confirms one
Promises a refund of the premium or any compensation
Says which team was right or that anyone lied about the rebooking
Answers his message with a warning about his language, or with a stock apology that ignores that he apologised and has been failed twice
expected.reference_message: Reconciliation requested for DL-6155 (premium timed service, sender Ansel Eckersall). You asked for what Dispatch have: on 20 May at 09:30 Dispatch told this desk on Dispatch chat that their board showed the collection 'rebooked for 21 May AM'. Your record on 22 May shows only the 18 May job, closed 'not attempted, route over capacity', and nothing after it. Nobody attended on 21 May. The parcel has never been collected and is still at the sender's address, so this is not a loss; the support line nonetheless told him on 22 May to file a claim for it. Please reconcile the two records and book a real collection on your system, then confirm the date and window to me. For priority: he paid the premium rate for collection on 18 May and delivery on 20 May, has waited in on two days for no van, and his buyer is waiting. He is also asking for the premium back, which I will raise separately with billing once the collection is real. I have not given him a date.
